advisories.summary: DOH-Sarasota issued a mosquito-borne illness advisory after a confirmed locally-acquired West Nile case. Mosquito control has already treated the area. Cover up, use repellent, and report dead birds.
DOH-Orange reports five locally-acquired dengue cases. Aerial spraying is planned. Cover up and use repellent.
DOH-Hillsborough continues response to an ongoing dengue outbreak. Use repellent and drain standing water.
